hypothesis: Y053–Y055 confirmed that balanced schedule diversification reduces worst-onset aggregate loss across prespecified uniform scenarios. Under skewed future shock-onset frequencies that are unknown to the controller, hedging may reduce worst-case regret relative to selecting a fixed schedule, at a mean-loss cost. Test four fixed onset-mixture shifts prospectively, without event-informed scheduling.
freeze: Freeze fresh dev2256..2263, sealed heldout2264..2279, four new affine families, same frozen A/B schedules, 50/50 external parity assignment, shock regimes steady/onset4/5/6/7 and exact public sensor budget. Four fixed distributions each assign 70% to one onset among4/5/6/7 and 10% to each other onset. Use matched underlying world outcomes only once per cohort and compute predeclared weighted population risk ex post.
measure: Compute each arm's expected aggregate mismatch loss under each frozen shock-onset probability mixture from the same heldout trial outcomes. Oracle benchmark is best of fixed A/B per known mixture, diagnostic only; each arm's regret=weighted loss - minimum fixed-arm weighted loss. Worst regret = max across four distributions; additionally report uniform-mixture pooled loss and raw risk by onset. Preserve all adverse scenarios.
criterion: MIXTURE_MINIMAX_REGRET_GAIN iff hedge worst mixture regret <=0.65*min(fixed_A_worst_regret,fixed_B_worst_regret), uniform hedge expected loss <=1.10*best fixed uniform loss, and every arm has zero steady mismatches with exactly ten landmark scalar reads per run; PARTIAL_REGRET_GAIN iff regret <=0.85 and uniform loss <=1.2; NO_GAIN otherwise.
controls: Mixture weights are an evaluator-only future-frequency assumption; they are NEVER given to the scheduler in an individual run. Best-for-mixture fixed policy is non-deployable hindsight comparator only
Across independent trials schedule allocation precommitted by parity and evenly split 8/8, one-bit external allocation metadata, no within-run adaptation or event oracle
Pinned Y053/Y054/Y055 matched canonical evaluator, original seven active/nine cached/sixteen total and ten scalar landmark readings per trial
One immutable first-use evidence artifact, complete pytest, preserve negative and mixed outcomes, no sealed replay, promotion or authority mutation
claim_limit: Synthetic exogenous population shock-frequency minimax regret analysis, NOT event forecasting or independently sourced physical transfer.
